name: Breeze Canna x 5 Infused Bangers | Rainbow Sherbet
description: The Breeze full flavor, full effect in a preroll. A colorful blend of fruity flavors that captures the essence of creamy rainbow sherbet in every puff. Enhanced with beta caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene terpenes, this nostalgic treat delivers relaxed, uplifting, and focused effects that bring back all the good times.
